status_definitions.observed_pass: Confirmed by source reading plus a real bound screenshot/interaction or an independent frozen-image challenge

status_definitions.pending: No sufficient observation; not silently treated as passing

limitations: Desktop Chromium and Chromium touch emulation only. Contest WebView host unknown; no actual Android/iOS device claim.

Same-realm generated game can falsify its own mechanics/snapshot under deliberate adversarial intent. Source reading and external ordinary/illegal-input scenarios reduce accidental defect risk but are not a hostile proof.
Scores assess the five deliberately small frozen tasks, not arbitrary genres, game depth, entertainment quality, asset originality or unbiased participant preference.
Optional audio observations are scheduling/context lifetime, not perceived sound quality.
Missing or failed provider runs have no playable artifact and receive null rubric scores, never fabricated zero gameplay quality or assumed passes.

source_findings: Actual arena pointerdown transforms coordinates using bounding rectangle to logical360×360 and invokes the same circular hit test as keyboard input. Only alive targets can score. Repeated pointer shot at an eliminated target counts a miss, not extra damage.
Three misses set lost; three distinct hits set won. Fixed-step target movement pauses using game/runtime lifecycle. Audio tone only follows a successful hit.
Visual revision preserves target geometry, motion, hit/miss economy, keyboard/pointer path and tone, adding presentation-only hit effects and separate color values.

source_findings: PLAY_CARD accepts only a card remaining in the human hand and phase=playing. It removes each human/bot card once and computes scores from actual values.

Bot card uses the fixed order[2,3,1] indexed by completed rounds, never the current human value or any future selection. This property is supported by source inspection; observed orders agree across all six human permutations.
